derivative_interpretation.capsule_exact_smooth_side_hessian: radial curvature n*n^T plus Eprime/rho*(I-axis*axis^T-n*n^T); Eprime=-normal_force, rho=gap+radius
derivative_interpretation.captured_operator: radial barrier curvature plus signed capsule-side geometric curvature; friction is zero here
derivative_interpretation.signed_geometric_curvature_status: included in the captured operator for this source snapshot
derivative_interpretation.stiffness_branch: inertial max branch is active in both selected samples; derivative of inactive impact stiffness is zero locally
derivative_interpretation.system_action: negative derivative of the node impulse residual with respect to velocity correction

fp32_armijo_representability.interpretation: binary32 arithmetic emulation reconstructs the accepted state from captured candidate u/v; it is not a second Metal execution

limitations: This local capsule calculation excludes the assembled FEM stiffness, other contacts, cohesive terms, and global residual interactions.
The finite-difference replay is continuous FP64 for the captured smooth capsule-side feature. It does not reproduce all Metal rounding or feature-switch guards.
A local 1.8% operator discrepancy is not evidence by itself that it caused the global nonlinear plateau.

native_run.run_interpretation: the selected Newton trial may be accepted even when the native process later exits unsuccessfully; this receipt is run-level

scope.model: one FEM free node against one prescribed identity-pose capsule, capsule axis world +Y; local node contact sample replay only

selected_contacts_total_action.scope: sum of the two selected local sample actions, not the complete assembled contact or FEM residual
